headerDisplay:
First Alert

The **First Alert** plugin allows you to control and monitor First Alert smoke and carbon monoxide detectors from HomeKit and Matter.
footerDisplay: Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-firstalert/issues).

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of First Alert devices to manage.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Unique identifier for this device (e.g. MAC address or serial number).

name.title: Name
name.description: Friendly name for this device as shown in HomeKit/Matter.

deviceType.title: Device Type
deviceType.description: Select the type of First Alert detector.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable this device without removing it from the config.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter Support (Override)
enableMatter.description: Allow Matter support unless it is disabled here. By default, Matter availability is auto-detected from the Homebridge configuration, and this setting cannot force Matter on if Homebridge has it disabled or unavailable.

preferMatter.title: Prefer Matter when available
preferMatter.description: If enabled and Matter is available, devices will be presented as native Matter accessories instead of HAP accessories. Requires Homebridge v2.0+ with Matter enabled.
